summary_en: The video demonstrates a cooking tutorial where chefs prepare ingredients, chop vegetables and shrimp, whisk eggs with flour, mix everything together, and pan-fry the mixture into golden patties. Afterward, they prepare a dipping sauce, cut and taste the dish, and conclude the culinary program.
